name: gcp-auth
description: Mints short-lived access tokens for a Google Cloud service account on the host, with your own gcloud login, and hands the container only those: gcloud and the Google client libraries use them as if running on GCE.

settings.label: Service account
settings.description: The account the sandbox acts as; your login needs roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator on it.

settings.label: Project
settings.description: Default project for gcloud and the client libraries. Default: the one in the account's email.

settings.label: Credential file
settings.description: Workload identity federation config used instead of your gcloud login.
